title: Kiri: a lightweight Docker Desktop alternative

facts.method: Maker benchmark: alpine true, start and remove; median 30 Docker Engine API runs.
facts.limits: One benchmark workload, not a general performance guarantee; Windows requires WSL 2.

scenes.say: Your containers could launch without Docker Desktop. Meet Kiri.
scenes.heading: A LIGHTER CONTAINER RUNTIME

scenes.say: Kiri runs your Docker images and works with the Docker commands and Compose you already use.
scenes.heading: KEEP YOUR WORKFLOW

scenes.say: In Kiri’s own test, starting and removing a tiny container took two point five five milliseconds, versus two hundred thirteen for Docker Desktop.
scenes.heading: ONE TEST, TWO RESULTS

scenes.say: That is a median of thirty runs through the Docker API, not a guarantee for every app.
scenes.heading: READ THE FINE PRINT

scenes.say: It supports Mac, Linux and Windows. On Windows it requires W S L two.
scenes.heading: WORKS ACROSS PLATFORMS

scenes.say: Want the repo? Comment Kiri and follow Hypeless for more tools, minus the hype.
scenes.heading: YOUR CALL

idea: Keep Docker workflows while testing a lighter runtime.

claims.text: Kiri supports Docker images and the Docker CLI and Compose.
In the project benchmark, median Docker Engine API times were 2.55 ms for Kiri and 213 ms for Docker Desktop across 30 runs.

proof_plan.how_shown: Annotated official README and a conceptual command flow.
Proportional comparison, labeled maker benchmark and workload.

review.notes: Research complete; visual and audio review pending.
